R428.note: Escapes rawComment at the point it enters the template with the same entity encoder already used for authorName; helper rename is internal and output for authorName is unchanged.

R429.note: Removes the shell entirely in favour of fopen/fgets/str_contains, which matches grep -F literal substring semantics; the mechanism swap is stated plainly and only the unreadable-log error text differs from grep's stderr.

R430.note: Keeps the cookie format and restricts unserialize to allowed_classes => [ShoppingCart::class], so legitimate carts still restore while foreign classes become __PHP_Incomplete_Class with no magic methods.

R431.note: password_verify plus rehash is the right API, but the original == only worked because users.password holds plaintext, so every existing account is locked out until a migration the write-up only mentions conditionally as a follow-up.

R432.note: Entity-encodes both req.params.id and req.query.note at interpolation into HTML body text; server-side ticket fields are correctly left alone.

R433.note: bcrypt.compare against the stored hash with a dummy-hash fallback is the right shape; the unified 'Invalid username or password' message is stated hardening, though the passwordHash field name is assumed from an unseen User model.

R434.note: IAntiforgery.ValidateRequestAsync in the JSON-bound handler with a configured HeaderName is the documented Minimal API pattern; the added token-issuing GET endpoint and required header are stated plainly and are inherent to the fix.

R435.note: encode_entities($cgi->param('note')) calls param() in list context, so a second note= value becomes encode_entities' unsafe-chars argument and the first value is emitted unencoded - reproduced in scratch: encode_entities('<script>alert(1)</script>','z') returns the string unchanged, so a duplicate-parameter request still injects.

R436.note: Compares the resolved path against a separator-terminated normalized base with OrdinalIgnoreCase, closing the sibling-prefix bypass; existing Forbid/NotFound/File responses unchanged.

R437.note: check_password for hashed rows plus constant-time compare and in-place rehash for legacy plaintext rows is the right shape, but hmac.compare_digest on str raises TypeError for non-ASCII input (reproduced in scratch), so a legacy user with a non-ASCII password now gets an unhandled exception instead of a login, which the write-up does not mention.

R438.note: serializer.save(owner=self.request.user) is the DRF-documented binding point and overrides any client-supplied owner in validated_data; serializer contract and other actions untouched.

R439.note: %15s bounds the write to the 16-byte buffer, and the peek/drain/ungetc logic rejects over-long tokens with -1 while leaving the trailing delimiter unread, matching the stated contract.

R440.note: Sniffs the first 512 bytes with http.DetectContentType, reassembles the stream with io.MultiReader, and stores under a server-generated name with a matching extension; the returned name is the stored name and all existing error shapes are preserved, with the filename change stated plainly.
